title: Move vault ignore rules to a shared module and pin the .sbignore glob dialect
description: Found in P1-08. No ignore implementation existed in backend/vault/, so conformance.py carries its own read_sbignore/is_ignored/note_paths. The indexer (P1-21) needs the same rules and must not duplicate them: move the helper to a shared vault module that both import. Plan 2.9 says only 'one vault-relative glob per line'; the helper chose fnmatch over the full relative path (so * matches /), trailing / for directories. Pin the dialect in plan 2.9 and the skill.

title: Restructure repo into second-brain/, web-app/, claude-workflow/
description: User decision 2026-10-05. Three independent top-level folders: second-brain/ = vault source only (templates, vault README, init script, golden sample vault); the real vault stays at D:\Second Brain outside this repo. web-app/ = backend/ (Django API, indexer, writer, existing parser and checker), dashboard/ (React app), docker-compose.yml and .env.example. claude-workflow/ = skills/, commands/, install.sh, tests/ (agents/ and workflows/ only when they have content); installs globally into ~/.claude. Do it as one dedicated change after the running reviews finish: move folders, update plan, spec, CLAUDE.md, every path and test, re-run all suites. Record as a confirmed decision in the spec.
close_reason: Restructured 2026-10-05 into second-brain/, web-app/, claude-workflow/ with git mv (144 renames). Suites after the move (orchestrator runs): second-brain 394, claude-workflow 740 (+25 live deselected), backend 685, spike selftest 17/17, shellcheck clean, checker 19 lines; counts reconcile file for file with before. Plan section 6, task Files/Run lines, spec, spike doc, fixture README and CLAUDE.md updated. One drvfs glitch during git mv of the spike folder was repaired; files byte-identical to HEAD.

title: Flaky checks: process-group kill test deadline and spike 'skew' selftest duration
description: Seen during the restructure: claude-workflow test_harness.py::test_kill_stops_the_whole_process_group failed once under full-suite load (timing deadline), passed alone and on reruns. The spike selftest 'skew' case once got 3 samples where it needs 4 and reported duration_s 1.0 although --duration 3 was requested; passed on rerun. The second may be a real bug in measure.py skew.

title: install.sh must not install __pycache__ or .pyc files from the skill directory
description: Found while fixing vault_git.py: a __pycache__/vault_git.cpython-312.pyc appeared beside claude-workflow/skills/second-brain/scripts/vault_git.py (something imported the script without disabling bytecode). install.sh copies everything under skills/second-brain, so a stale .pyc could be installed into ~/.claude and, without -I... python would still prefer the source, but a cache must not ship. Exclude __pycache__ directories and *.pyc in install.sh, with a test, and find what wrote the cache (a test that imports the script?).
